Hey there! I'm André (or Gustavo, I go by both). I'm a data builder working across different stages of the data lifecycle: Ingestion, Transformation, Delivery.

I've built custom ETL libraries, and dashboards for end users, web pages in django, and Flask APIs to communicate between different services! My passion is Mathematics and I enjoy building data inference, like risk simulation, time series forecasting, and classification (regressions, trees and neural networks).

You can check a detailed history of my accomplishments at [Experience](/experience.qmd).
